updates.title: What’s New / Updates and console metadata
updates.changed: Added a shared update history for user-facing changes, plus visible console version, effective date, last updated date, owner, collaborator, and next review information.
checks: Open What’s New / Updates from the sidebar or the version chip in the header.
Confirm Console Version 1.0, Owner Cjei A., Collaborator Nina F., and the review dates are visible.
Confirm update entries show both What changed and What to check.

updates.title: Duplicate combined Suggested Script removed
updates.changed: Removed the long combined Suggested Script block that repeated scripts already shown under individual steps. Per-step scripts remain where they are needed, while source-level scripts are shown once as Additional Source Script.
checks: Open a process with multiple scripted steps and confirm the giant duplicate script block is gone.
Confirm each relevant step still has its own Suggested Script and Copy Script control.
If a process has a source-level script, confirm it appears once as Additional Source Script.

updates.title: Smart Search and live suggestions
updates.changed: Search now normalizes case, apostrophes, punctuation, and spacing; understands controlled support aliases and synonyms; tolerates close typos; shows suggestions from short prefixes; keeps the list to six results; keeps the dropdown fully visible; and opens the exact process selected.
checks: Search cant jion, camra, bluetooh, and meeting control and confirm useful suggestions appear while typing.
Confirm the suggestions are fully visible over the content below the search field.
Click a suggestion and confirm the process that opens has the same title as the selected suggestion.

updates.title: Responsive sidebar and compact header stabilized
updates.changed: Unified the authenticated console at the 800px breakpoint, fixed tablet overlap and hidden-sidebar slivers, added click-outside closing, closed the drawer after navigation, exposed menu state for accessibility, and corrected the compact Zoom Support Console brand alignment.
checks: At desktop width, confirm the sidebar remains normally visible.
At 768px or mobile width, confirm the hamburger opens the drawer and the backdrop closes it.
Confirm the closed drawer leaves no strip on the left edge and the header brand does not stack or collide.

updates.title: Accessible category icons and keyboard search controls
updates.changed: Added distinct visual icons to support category cards and retained keyboard-friendly search suggestion controls so agents can move through suggestions with the keyboard.
checks: Confirm every support category card has a distinct visible icon.
In search, use Arrow Up or Arrow Down, Enter, and Escape and confirm the suggestion list responds correctly.
